commands: for n in coolify coolify-db coolify-redis coolify-realtime coolify-proxy coolify-sentinel; do if docker inspect "$n" >/dev/null 2>&1; then h=$(docker inspect --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}no-healthcheck{{end}} | {{.State.Status}} | restart={{.RestartCount}} | {{.State.StartedAt}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null); echo "$n | $h"; else echo "$n | NOT_FOUND"; fi; done

docker ps -a --filter name=coolify-proxy --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' 2>/dev/null; docker inspect coolify-proxy --format 'Running={{.State.Running}} Health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}n/a{{end}}' 2>/dev/null || true
echo running=$(docker ps -q | wc -l) total=$(docker ps -aq | wc -l)
docker ps --format '{{.Label "com.docker.compose.project"}}' 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -30
